purpose: Collect registrations or expressions of interest for a defined event without replacing a full ticketing system.

fields.label: Dietary or Accessibility Notes
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible optional label; do not force sensitive disclosure.

confirmations.name: Default
confirmations.message: Thanks for registering. We will email you the next event details.

notifications.name: Event admin notification
notifications.message: Send attendee details and selected session to the event owner.

feeds.name: Optional marketing follow-up
feeds.condition: Only if consent and add-on connection are confirmed.

spam_settings.turnstile: only if add-on and keys are confirmed

data_retention_notes: Retain event registration entries only as long as operationally required; review Personal Data settings. Consent record and wording must be reviewed for retention, export, and erase handling.
risks: If payments or ticket inventory are needed, route to WooCommerce/event ticketing architecture before using this form.
